## isva-p07-v55 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (closing)

**Question.** Proved — yet for whom in vain?

**Premises.**
- Though proved by a thousand blazing reasons (samujjvalan nyāyasahasrasādhito'py upaiti).
- It succeeds not for the deluded-minded (siddhiṃ na vimūḍhacetasām).
- Maheśvara, placed on the palm, yet flees the fate-struck — the true jewel (maheśvaraḥ pāṇitalasthito'pi san palāyate daivahatasya sanmaṇiḥ).

**Inference.** Proof needs fitness; the jewel flees the fated.
